blocks.prompt: 13. The first four terms of an A.P. are 2, 6, 10 and 14. Find the least number of terms needed so that the sum of the terms is greater than 2000.
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein "barabar" nahi, "se zyada" hai: jama 2000 se zyada hona chahiye, aur humein sab se kam terms chahiye. Yeh inequality (ghair-masawat, \(>\) wala rishta) ka sawal hai.
Diya kya hai? A.P. 2, 6, 10, 14, ...
Find kya karna hai? Sab se chhota whole number \(n\) jis ke liye \(S_n > 2000\).
Plan: \(S_n\) ko \(n\) ke formula mein likhna, inequality solve karna, phir agla poora number chunna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(2,\ 6,\ 10,\ 14,\ \dots\)
Humein find karna hai: sab se kam \(n\) jis ke liye \(S_n > 2000\).
Tareeqa: \(a_1 = 2\) aur \(d = 6 - 2 = 4\). \(S_n\) ka formula \(n\) mein likh kar \(S_n > 2000\) solve karenge. Yaad rahe, terms ki tadaad hamesha positive whole number hoti hai, aadhi term nahi ho sakti.

\(S_n\) nikalein
\[S_n = \dfrac{n}{2}[2(2) + (n - 1)4]\]
\[= \dfrac{n}{2}(4 + 4n - 4)\]
\[= \dfrac{n}{2}(4n) = 2n^2\]
Kyun: \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2a_1 + (n - 1)d]\) mein values rakhin. \((n - 1)4 = 4n - 4\), aur \(4 - 4\) cancel ho gaya. Bohat saaf formula mila: \(S_n = 2n^2\). (Check: \(S_2 = 2 + 6 = 8 = 2 \times 4\).)

Inequality banayein
\[2n^2 > 2000\]
\[n^2 > 1000\]
Kyun: Dono taraf 2 se divide kiya. Inequality ko positive number se divide karein to nishan \(>\) wohi rehta hai; sirf negative se multiply ya divide karne par ulat jata hai.

Solve karein
\[n > \sqrt{1000} \approx 31.6\]
Kyun: \(n\) positive hai, is liye sirf positive square root. \(\sqrt{1000}\) ka andaza: \(31^2 = 961\) (1000 se kam) aur \(32^2 = 1024\) (1000 se zyada), to \(\sqrt{1000}\) 31 aur 32 ke beech, taqreeban 31.6 hai.

Sab se chhota whole number chunein
\[n = 32\]
Kyun: \(n\) ko 31.6 se bara hona hai aur whole number bhi. 31 chhota hai, is liye 32.
Dhyan dein: 31.6 ko round kar ke 31 likhna ghalat hai; yahan hamesha upar wala number lete hain kyunke shart "se zyada" ki hai.

Tasdeeq
\[S_{31} = 2(31)^2 = 1922 < 2000\]
\[S_{32} = 2(32)^2 = 2048 > 2000 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 31 terms ka jama 1922 hai jo 2000 tak nahi pahuncha; 32 terms par jama 2048 ho kar pehli dafa 2000 se aage nikla. Is liye kam se kam 32 terms chahiye.
blocks.final_answer:
\(n = 32\) terms
Answer key bhi 32 deti hai.
